verses.text: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, I give to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.
And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.
You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.
The LORD bless you, and keep you. The LORD make his face to shine on you, and be gracious to you. The LORD lift up his face towards you, and give you peace.
In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you alone, the LORD, make me live in safety.

The LORD is my shepherd; I shall lack nothing. He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters. He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.
The LORD will give strength to his people. The LORD will bless his people with peace.
“Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted amongst the nations. I will be exalted in the earth.”
My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.
I will hear what God, the LORD, will speak, for he will speak peace to his people, his saints; but let them not turn again to folly.
Those who love your law have great peace. Nothing causes them to stumble.
Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.
I have set the LORD always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved. Therefore my heart is glad, and my tongue rejoices. My body shall also dwell in safety.
But the humble shall inherit the land, and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
Mark the perfect man, and see the upright, for there is a future for the man of peace.
The work of righteousness will be peace, and the effect of righteousness, quietness and confidence forever.
For thus said the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel, “You will be saved in returning and rest. Your strength will be in quietness and in confidence.” You refused.
For a child is born to us. A son is given to us; and the government will be on his shoulders. His name will be called Wonderful Counsellor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.
For the mountains may depart, and the hills be removed, but my loving kindness will not depart from you, and my covenant of peace will not be removed, says the LORD who has mercy on you.
For you shall go out with joy, and be led out with peace. The mountains and the hills will break out before you into singing; and all the trees of the fields will clap their hands.
Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God.
Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls.
“Glory to God in the highest, on earth peace, good will towards men.”
As they said these things, Jesus himself stood amongst them, and said to them, “Peace be to you.”
I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have trouble; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.

When therefore it was evening on that day, the first day of the week, and when the doors were locked where the disciples were assembled, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the middle and said to them, “Peace be to you.”
Jesus therefore said to them again, “Peace be to you. As the Father has sent me, even so I send you.”
Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ.
For the mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace.
If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.
So then, let’s follow after things which make for peace, and things by which we may build one another up.
Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.
For God is not a God of confusion but of peace, as in all the assemblies of the saints.
Finally, brothers, rejoice! Be perfected. Be comforted. Be of the same mind. Live in peace, and the God of love and peace will be with you.
But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith, gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.
For he is our peace, who made both one, and broke down the middle wall of separation.
And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body, and be thankful.
Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in all ways. The Lord be with you all.
Follow after peace with all men, and the sanctification without which no man will see the Lord.

But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceful, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy. Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.
Let him turn away from evil and do good. Let him seek peace and pursue it.
Her ways are ways of pleasantness. All her paths are peace.
The life of the body is a heart at peace, but envy rots the bones.
The LORD, you will ordain peace for us, for you have also done all our work for us.
The latter glory of this house will be greater than the former,’ says the LORD of Armies; ‘and in this place I will give peace,’ says the LORD of Armies.
These are the things that you shall do: speak every man the truth with his neighbour. Execute the judgement of truth and peace in your gates.
Depart from evil, and do good. Seek peace, and pursue it.
He makes peace in your borders. He fills you with the finest of the wheat.
But the souls of the righteous are in the hand of God, and no torment will touch them.
The fear of the Lord is the crown of wisdom, making peace and perfect health to flourish.

messages.text: Peace I leave with you; My peace I give to you. Receive it now.
Peace is not the absence of noise. It is the presence of Christ.
Rest in this moment. God is here, and all is well in His hands.
Let your peace overflow to others. Blessed are the peacemakers.
Pray the Prayer of Saint Francis: Lord, make me an instrument of Your peace.
A peaceful heart is a gift. Thank God for it, and protect it.
Spend a few minutes in silence before God. Let peace go deeper.
The Lord bless you and keep you, and give you peace.
Peace grows when we forgive. Is there someone you can make peace with today?
Let God's peace rule in your heart, like a referee who calls the game.
When peace fills your heart, share it with a kind word.
Mary is Queen of Peace. Ask her to keep your heart calm and close to her Son.
Calm waters reflect the sky. A quiet heart reflects God.
Be still and know that He is God. Enjoy His presence.
Peace be with you, the risen Jesus said. He says it to you too.
Breathe slowly and thank God for this calm moment.
True peace comes from being right with God. Keep your heart close to Him.
Pray for peace in your family, your country and the world.
In His will is our peace. Rest there today.
When the world rushes, choose to walk slowly with God.
Let your home be a place of peace, where everyone feels welcome.
Peace is a fruit of the Spirit. Ask Him to grow it in you.
Saint Francis de Sales said: Do not lose your inner peace for anything whatsoever.
A calm heart gives life to the body. Enjoy this gift.
Visit Jesus in the Blessed Sacrament and simply rest in His presence.
Peace is the fruit of trust. Keep trusting God.
Let go of what you cannot control, and rest in the One who controls all things.
Let peace guide your words today. Speak gently.
The Lord gives strength to His people and blesses them with peace.
Seek peace and pursue it. Peace is worth the effort.
Christ is our peace. He breaks down walls and brings people together.
Pray the Rosary slowly, and let each bead bring you deeper into God's peace.
A peaceful moment is a good time to listen for God. What is He saying to you?
Live at peace with everyone, as far as it depends on you.
Your peace is a witness to God's goodness. Let it shine.
Thank God for this quiet season. Rest and grow strong.
The peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your heart.
Let your peace be a prayer for those who are troubled tonight.
Great peace have those who love God's law. Spend time in His Word today.
Choose peace over being right. It is often the holier choice.
Holy Spirit, fill me with Your peace, and let it flow through me to others.
Glory to God in the highest, and peace to His people on earth.
Enjoy the beauty of creation today. It speaks of God's peaceful love.
Peace is not passive. Work for justice, kindness and reconciliation.
Keep your peace by keeping your eyes on Jesus.
Mountains may shake, but God's covenant of peace will not be removed.
Let the evening be calm. Hand the day back to God with thanks.
The way of wisdom is a way of pleasantness, and all her paths are peace.
Carry this peace into tomorrow. God goes with you.
Rest tonight in perfect peace, your mind stayed on God.
